hyperparameters.method: Scale E[min | play] so that sum(P(play) x E[min|play]) = 241.5 per team-game; paired MAE.

hypothesis: Team-level consistency (the incumbent's water-filling idea) removes errors.
limitations: Hard budget constraints move minutes toward players whose uncertainty is not team-level.

point.result: Development +0.004 (95% CI -0.001 to +0.011); validation +0.009 (95% CI -0.003 to +0.019) min MAE (normalised minus raw).

question: Does forcing each team's expected minutes to sum to 240 (+OT) improve player minutes?
